checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=1 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.29 tightness=1.74 base_volume_vs_leg=0.56 base_volume_vs_avg=0.82
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 1 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 15.2% vs its 20-SMA, 29.3% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The C check is a hard FAIL: the base is only 1 session long (outside Bonde's required 3–20) and tightness of 1.74 far exceeds the 1.0 threshold, meaning there is no real consolidation to burst from. The prior day was a -6.56% wide red bar (7.3% range), and the signal bar itself opens near the prior close and runs hard, but the 'base' is literally a single session with a breakdown recorded — there is no orderly quiet period visible on the chart. The move is also visibly extended, with the close 15.2% above the 20-SMA after a 33.5% leg gain in 21 sessions.
claude.key_risk: No real consolidation exists; the burst is coming off a single wide down-day, making the setup structurally unsound and vulnerable to a sharp reversal.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal day's high (~$117.84) or if the stock opens below the signal day's close ($116.61) with no immediate buying interest in the first 30 minutes.
